INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 1.1.1 Attentive Listening: Poetry.

   D. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening: Poetry.

   A. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Avoid speaking to classmates
